title: Draft a respectful networking message
description: Write a short, relevant introduction with one modest request.
accomplishes: Write a short, relevant introduction with one modest request. Use only genuine context and allow an easy decline. Do not pretend to know the recipient, fabricate shared interests or schedule unsolicited bulk messaging.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Draft a respectful networking message.

Input context:
- RECIPIENT CONTEXT: [RECIPIENT CONTEXT]
- REAL CONNECTION: [REAL CONNECTION]
- PURPOSE: [PURPOSE]
- CHANNEL: [CHANNEL]

Write a short, relevant introduction with one modest request. Use only genuine context and allow an easy decline. Do not pretend to know the recipient, fabricate shared interests or schedule unsolicited bulk messaging.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Networking draft
“Hello, I appreciated your public explanation of workflow review. I work on related service processes and would value one clarification about your approach, if you have time.” Replace the context only with something actually known. The draft does not assume a relationship and is not sent or added to an automated campaign.
